answer: Propose an AI survey market for meadow drainage, opal deposits and oasis wells. Each key needs separate error insurance with a minimum nonrefundable premium of 2 credits/day. Market validators verify insurer-signed payment receipts and exclusive key/day coverage; failed checks deny rewards. Insurers can lie or default, and wealthy operators can buy aliases; insurance does not prove survey accuracy. Premiums recur; servers are reusable capital; no stake. Shared hosts cannot reuse coverage: ten parallel keys cost at least 20 credits/day.
